title: Semiconducting SnO2 nanoparticles for surface-enhanced Raman scattering applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21740-21755
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08335D, Paper

P. Surya Lakshmi, B. Mohanarao, P. Babuji, P. V. Prakash Madduri, L. Jyothi, G. Krishna Podagatlapalli, K. H. Chae, G. S. Chang, V. Saikiran
This study reports the synthesis of SnO2 nanoparticles using a sol–gel method and thermal annealing at 800 and 900 °C to optimise their structural and surface properties for non-plasmonic semiconductor-based SERS applications.
